# istio_envoy_filter (Resource)

Manages an Istio EnvoyFilter resource. EnvoyFilters provide a low-level mechanism to customize the Envoy proxy configuration generated by Istiod.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "istio_envoy_filter" "custom_header" {
  manifest = jsonencode({
    apiVersion = "networking.istio.io/v1alpha3"
    kind       = "EnvoyFilter"
    metadata = {
      name      = "custom-response-header"
      namespace = "istio-system"
    }
    spec = {
      configPatches = [
        {
          applyTo = "HTTP_FILTER"
          match = {
            context = "SIDECAR_INBOUND"
            listener = {
              filterChain = {
                filter = {
                  name = "envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager"
                }
              }
            }
          }
          patch = {
            operation = "INSERT_BEFORE"
            value = {
              name = "envoy.filters.http.lua"
              typed_config = {
                "@type"    = "type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.lua.v3.Lua"
                inlineCode = "function envoy_on_response(response_handle)\n  response_handle:headers():add(\"X-Custom-Header\", \"true\")\nend"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) Full EnvoyFilter manifest as a JSON string. Must include `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata.name`, and `metadata.namespace`. The `apiVersion` in the manifest determines which API version is used (e.g. `networking.istio.io/v1alpha3` or an older version like `v1beta1`). Sensitive fields (tokens, keys, passwords, etc.) are redacted to "(redacted)" in state after read.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/name` (or `name` for cluster-scoped resources).
